newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY STAT OFFICE REVISES Q1 1996 GDP.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY STAT OFFICE REVISES Q1 1996 GDP.

text.p: Hungary's Central Statistical Office (KSH) revised the change of the country's first quarter 1996 year-on-year GDP upwards, KSH said in a statement on Monday.

In contrast with the previous data according to which Hungary's GDP fell one percent in the January-March period in 1996 from the same three months in 1995, the overall economic performance remained unchanged, KSH said.

"Based on the check and correction of basic information, and on data which arrived with delay, KSH revised the previous estimates and modified the figures," the statement said. "This resulted in a one percentage point change in the GDP."
